# SLA (Service Level Agreement) in this project

SLA stands for Service Level Agreement (اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة). In this project it means the agreed time to complete a work order (أمر شغل): the time a follow-up action is expected to take once it is opened. KPIs are computed from it: whether each work order is closed within its agreed time, and how far past it the late ones run.

## Relation to the project indicators
- The inspection file's "what we do" part proposes an action, an owner role, a due date and an escalation trigger; the due date is the work order's agreed time.
- K3 (months since the first announced handover date) and the Decree 2184/2022 periods (12-month grace, 24-month refund right) are legal clocks on the developer, not SLAs on the committee.
- An SLA KPI for the committee would be, for example, "share of cycle-list visits completed within the agreed time"; the visit form (ops_visits) records the dates needed to compute it once real visits are logged.

## ISO
ISO is the International Organization for Standardization. In this project it refers to its standards, in particular the city indicator standards ISO 37120 and ISO 37122 (see the separate ISO note).
